findings.message: ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 6 of 6 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 22050 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 11025 Hz.
6 raw data blocks hold an SBR header whose frequency tables cannot be built: bs_xover_band 2 lies beyond the 2 bands of the master frequency table; the first at 0x4D.
